metadata.title: When Elon Musk founded SpaceX, he thought it was 'gonna fail' - MarketWatch

content.text:
4 days ago
When Elon Musk founded SpaceX, he thought it was 'gonna fail'
Even Elon Musk finds it "hard to believe" that SpaceX, which he founded more than two decades ago in El Segundo, Calif., just had the biggest initial public offering of all time.
"If people told me this was gonna happen, I was like, 'Man you must be smoking some really good crack, because I think this company is gonna fail,'" Musk said on Friday just minutes before he rang the Nasdaq opening bell from SpaceX's headquarters in Starbase, Texas.
"I gave SpaceX less than 10% chance of succeeding at all," he added, sparking laughter from the people at the event, which included SpaceX investors and executives. Nasdaq also played Elton John's "Rocket Man" at the event.
